paper.title_en: 3D Modeling of an Inductive Oven for the DECRIS-PM ECR Ion Source
paper.abstract_en: A 3D numerical model of an inductive oven for the DECRIS-PM ECR ion source (FLNR JINR) has been developed to enable high-intensity metal ion beams for superheavy element research (Z  = 119, 120). Through coupled electromagnetic and thermal simulations, an optimized "cut plug" geometry was identified that enhances the heating efficiency by up to 33 %. The design satisfies magnetic safety requirements and is compatible with the existing source layout, providing a safe solution for the future metal ion beam experiments.
